brief.title: Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025
brief.one_liner: A data-driven comparison of top large language models ranked by their ability to autonomously write and edit code across six programming languages.
brief.goal: The viewer should understand which LLMs perform best at autonomous code editing, how accuracy trades off against cost, and how different model families (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek) compare on Aider's polyglot benchmark.

sections.title: About the Benchmark
sections.objective: Explain what the Aider polyglot benchmark measures: 225 Exercism coding exercises across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust, evaluated without human intervention.

sections.title: Top Models by Accuracy
sections.objective: Present a ranked comparison of the highest-scoring models, highlighting the top 10 with their percent-correct scores and edit formats.

sections.title: Cost vs. Accuracy Trade-Off
sections.objective: Visualize or tabulate how model cost per run relates to accuracy, showing that the most accurate models are not always the most expensive.

sections.title: Edit Format Compliance
sections.objective: Show how well each model follows the required edit format (correct edit format %), indicating reliability for automated workflows.

sections.title: Key Takeaways
sections.objective: Summarize the 3-4 most important insights: GPT-5 leads, cost varies dramatically, and several sub-$5 models still exceed 70% accuracy.
